Before buying, check that your phone is unlocked and supports the plan’s eSIM, and compare it with your U.S. carrier’s roaming offer. passages.original_summary: Local law prohibits photographs of military and government buildings in Algeria. Do not assume that an ordinary-looking building is open for photography; some official buildings display the Algerian flag. If you are unsure, put the camera away and ask. Keep your passport or a copy available for identity checks. These are legal precautions, not a description of how every local person behaves.
